task.title: Record the rebuilt failure-analysis answer contract on L5b and L1
task.objective: The failure-analysis answer contract was rebuilt at 5ef4852f: declining is an empty conclusion list, a direct cause must be interpreted, a bare runner failure can only be declined, and the runner's own failure record is never primary evidence. On the real Qwen3.5-0.8B, verify:ai-failure-analysis-live is 5/5 with all three analyses accepted and correctly classified, where under v1 every real answer was refused as CONTRADICTORY. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 giving the fix, the measurement and what stays open (latency at the 512-token cap, the largest conclusion citing all 11 candidates as primary, a model call spent on a bare runner timeout). Append a note to awkit-djnl.1 that failure-analysis answers are now accepted and that its latency gap is unchanged. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/ai-harness/locatorUpgradePacket.ts and scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the fix commit and the live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, against the state after `bd update awkit-djnl.8 --append-notes`, `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents. The tracker measured 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, so the hardcoded tracker pin did not move. Both narratives restate the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: failure-analysis contract fix noted on awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
